'''Goonbug''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Capobeetle]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Goonbug trains by doing five hundred sprints every day, and knows how to pretend to be a leaf to avoid danger. The perfect embodiment of brains and brawn combined. Well. The brain part is coming along nicely, at least."

Goonbug is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, green bug creature that resembles a male [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dynastes_tityus Hercules beetle]. Its wings and pupils are dark cyan. It has orange-yellow spots on its wings, and the tips of its horns are also orange-yellow.

Goonbug's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces dark cyan and orange-yellow with purple. It also becomes a lighter shade of green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Goonbug's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Capobeetle]] you need to complete the following task:
* Attempt Boss Challenge 10 times.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Goonbugs smell like chicken, but pack six times the protein of beef. Keep it away from the gym bros."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Though weak in strength, Goonbug flies swiftly. Hides among tree branches when attacked to masquerade as a leaf."
